verdict.rationale: Heap's Session Replay is documented as cueing replays to the exact event, and it lets you search a replay for errors and paths, so event-to-replay linkage exists. However, no evidence shows a direct jump from a funnel drop-off chart or an error event to the affected users' replays, and Session Replay is sold only as an add-on. missing for 10: documented funnel drop-off to replay drill-down, documented error-event to affected-user replay list, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users

citations.quote: Replays are automatically cued to the exact event you need. Easily track and search both client and server-side events within a replay for paths, errors, and clicked text.
